description.value: Bori Korean Restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue serves home-style Korean meals inspired by the nourishing qualities of barley ('Bori'), with a menu spanning traditional pancakes, deep-fried dishes, and hearty mains. The restaurant operates as both a sit-down dining room and a takeout spot, with online pick-up ordering available. It sits on a busy commercial corridor in North Vancouver that cyclists commonly travel when exploring the North Shore.
